headline: Katy Perry impresiona con su sencillo ‘Roar’

headline: RUSSIA IS IN DEBT WITH SNOWDEN FOR JULIAN ASSANGE, DENUNCIES OF FORMER CIA ANALYST WERE KEY TO REFORM OBAMAS SURVEILLANCE PROGRAMS
content: For Julian Assange, former analysts revelations were crucial for reforms in surveillance programs under President Obama who promised increased transparency. headline: SHAKHTAR EMERGE FROM THEIR FIRST GAME OF THE GERMAN LEAGUE SEASON DRAW AGAINST HSV

Jefferson Farfan played full ninety minutes contributing significantly towards Shaktar securing a draw away from home. Although initially leading through Huntelaar’s goal, Hamburg equalized twice thanks to efforts from Van Der Vaart and Beister but ultimately settled for a point courtesy of Szalaï’s late strike.
